messages:
taylor_csm: draft idea: a 1-page "Warmup + Guardrails" cheatline for AMs. Focus: what we do during warmup, conservative defaults to start, quick signals that mean "reach out", and a tiny operator script. short and copy/pasteable.

jeremy_sre: yes please. include: cache hit target, p95 threshold, and a circuit-breaker default. keep hosted defaults conservative.

ana_se: small note: add optional 24-72h prefill for customers with heavy templates. state when to skip prefill (sensitive content).

lia_am: renewal signals to call out: DAU drop >20% in 7d, >10% increase in support tickets in 72h, or persistent p95 >800ms -> AM outreach. also a 4-item handoff checklist.

taylor_csm: paste-ready hosted defaults (very short):
```yaml
warmup_defaults:
  prefill_enabled: true
  prefill_window_h: 24
  batch:
    max_batch_size: 12
    max_wait_ms: 100
  streaming_enabled: true
  cache_hit_target_pct: 65
  circuit_breaker_error_pct: 0.10
```

jeremy_sre: tiny warmup script for ops to run once:
```bash
for p in "welcome" "summary" "faq"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-hosted-small","input":"'$p'","prefill":true}' &
  done
wait
```

ana_se: troubleshooting 1-liners to include: cache hit <40% -> verify keys/prefill; p95 >900ms -> reduce max_batch_size; error% > CB -> page oncall.

lia_am: include line for customers: "During warmup (usually 24-48h) you may see slightly higher latency and costs while caches populate. We'll monitor and adjust." keep non-technical.

taylor_csm: I'll turn this into a single-page PDF and push to enablement. cc @deploy-bot to queue the PR.
